payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Boris, Ciara, Drew, Tara

payload.content: Planning note from Drew: My skill match is strongest on frontend/documentation. My best-cost task is ISSUE-0002::review (critical, cost 2.16). I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution. Please avoid duplicating it. What are each of you planning to take? I can flex to ISSUE-0002::test or ISSUE-0002::implement if needed to avoid conflicts.

Boris here. My skill is documentation (0.86) and my cheapest feasible tasks are the critical ISSUE-0002 ones. My private costs: ISSUE-0002::review=3.77, ::test=5.28, ::implement=7.54 (all other tasks cost >=16). Since Drew intends ISSUE-0002::review, I plan to claim ISSUE-0002::test (critical, cost 5.28) in execution. That leaves ISSUE-0002::implement for Ciara or Tara. Ciara/Tara, please state your picks so we cover all 3 critical tasks and avoid duplicates. I can flex to ISSUE-0002::implement if needed.

Tara here (planning, iter=1). My skills are mobile-development (0.94) and documentation (0.71), so I'm by far the most efficient on the ISSUE-0001 mobile tasks. My private costs: ISSUE-0001::triage=1.54, ::review=1.92, ::docs=1.92, ::test=2.69, ::implement=3.84; ISSUE-0002::review=4.40, ::test=6.16, ::implement=8.79.

Plan: I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (medium, cost 1.54) in execution — my cheapest task, and mobile tasks are expensive for the doc/frontend specialists. This keeps the critical ISSUE-0002 tasks free for Drew (::review), Boris (::test), and Ciara (::implement).

Ciara: please confirm you can take ISSUE-0002::implement so we cover all 3 critical tasks. If you can't, say so early and I can flex to ISSUE-0002::implement (cost 8.79) instead of the mobile task. Drew/Boris: if you'd rather shift, note that mobile tasks are very costly for you, so coordination is best if I stay on mobile.

Ciara here (planning, iter=1). Confirming the coordinated split to cover all 3 critical tasks + a mobile task:

- Drew: ISSUE-0002::review (your cheapest, 2.16)
- Boris: ISSUE-0002::test (5.28)
- Ciara (me): ISSUE-0002::implement — I can take it. effort 4.0 <= my 6.0h availability, my cost 4.62 (my review=2.31, test=3.24). I'll claim ISSUE-0002::implement in execution.
- Tara: ISSUE-0001::triage (1.54) — stay on mobile, you're by far the most efficient there.

This yields 4 tasks done (3 critical + 1 medium), priority_sum=3.5, no duplicates. Tara: no need to flex to implement — I've got it. Drew/Boris: please hold your picks (review/test) so we avoid duplicate-claim violations. If anyone must change, say so before execution.
